offering_description.value: OptimizeRx sells digital marketing and patient engagement services to pharmaceutical manufacturers and their agencies. It uses audience data to target campaigns and delivers promotional, affordability and patient support messages through electronic health records, e-prescribing systems and other digital channels.

primary_products.value: campaign activation software; audience targeting and analytics tools; patient engagement software

primary_services.value: digital advertising campaign management; point-of-care messaging; patient affordability and adherence communications; campaign measurement

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical and biotechnology manufacturers, and healthcare advertising agencies

end_markets.value: pharmaceutical and biotechnology commercialization; healthcare delivery

revenue_model.value: advertising: targeted digital campaigns and sponsored messages for clinicians and patients; project or contract: contracted patient engagement programs and campaign analytics

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: uses audience data and healthcare technology integrations to deliver campaigns for drugmakers and their agencies; service provider: turns client campaign briefs into targeted messaging programs and measures their performance

specialization.value: related lines: pharmaceutical advertising, clinician messaging, patient affordability and adherence programs, and campaign analytics

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams working with drugmakers and healthcare advertising agencies; partners / resellers: electronic health record vendors, e-prescribing networks and digital media partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA prescription drug promotion rules and health data privacy requirements, including HIPAA where applicable

notes: The size classification is approximate, and standalone software availability is uncertain.
